item.title: Gavin Newsom’s autobiography adds struggle to a story of a politically privileged past
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom's new memoir aims to reframe his privileged past by highlighting personal struggles, including his parents' divorce, his mother's cancer, and his own battles with alcohol while addressing his Getty family connections.

item.title: A divided SMC Board approves layoffs after hearing hours of criticism over their leadership
item.description: Santa Monica College's Board of Trustees voted Tuesday to approve layoffs of approximately 70 staff members facing a projected $16.7 million deficit. Critics spent hours condemning the board for what they called years of incompetent leadership that led to the crisis.

item.title: 3 dead as driver crashes through Westwood market
item.description: Three people were killed when a silver sedan crashed through the 99 Ranch Market on the corner of Westwood Blvd and Rochester Ave. Several others are reported injured and two are said to be in serious condition.The driver was described as an older woman around 70 years old. LAPD
